start: Owner, gym online, server has branches, one branch with 4 plans, on Settings

steps.action: In the "Branches" card tap "Add a branch"
user_sees: Sheet "Add a branch" with "Branch name", ticked "Copy this branch’s plans to the new branch" and six lines, e.g. "Every owner of this gym is an owner of the new branch too."
must_not: The sheet opens with the last typed name

steps.action: Type "Iron Temple, Vaishali Nagar" and tap "Add branch"
user_sees: "Adding…", then the sheet closes
"Iron Temple, Vaishali Nagar is added. 4 plans were copied to it. Next: open it and add its front-desk staff." and a button "Open Iron Temple, Vaishali Nagar"
must_not: Two branches made
The open branch changes by itself

steps.action: Read the branch list in the card
user_sees: The new row with its own gym code and "receipts start B2/<year>/0001"
The Branch list appears at the top of the panel
must_not: The new branch with the same receipt start as the first

start: Owner adds a branch with plans not copied

steps.action: Untick "Copy this branch’s plans to the new branch" and tap "Add branch"
user_sees: "<name> is added. Next: open it and add its front-desk staff." with no plans line
must_not: Plans copied anyway

steps.action: Tap "Open <name>"
user_sees: The new branch opens on Settings → Staff & sign-in
must_not: The first branch's staff in the new branch

start: Owner in the "Add a branch" sheet

steps.action: Type one letter and tap "Add branch"
user_sees: Red banner "Type the branch’s name, like “Iron Temple, Vaishali Nagar”."
must_not: A branch with a one-letter name

steps.action: Type the name of a branch that exists
user_sees: "A branch with this name already exists. Pick another name."
must_not: A second branch with the same name

steps.action: With 10 branches, add another
user_sees: "You already have 10 branches, the most for now. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp if you need more."
must_not: An 11th branch made

start: Owner whose gym is not online, or whose server has no branches yet

steps.action: Open Settings and find "Branches"
user_sees: Not online: "Have more than one gym? Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)…"
No branches on the server: "Branches are not switched on for your gym yet. Message MettleUp on WhatsApp to switch them on."
must_not: An "Add a branch" button that then fails

start: Owner opened the "Add a branch" sheet and typed a name

steps.action: Tap "Cancel"
user_sees: The sheet closes; the card unchanged
must_not: A branch made
An old error banner on the next open

steps.action: Add the branch for real
user_sees: The card words change to "Each branch has its own members, plans, receipts, front desk and QR poster…"
"Add a branch" turns into a quieter button
must_not: The "is added" line still showing after a reload as if new

start: Owner adds a second branch to a gym with 2 owners and 3 desk staff

steps.action: Add the branch and open it
user_sees: Both owners can open it
No desk staff in it until added there
must_not: The first branch's desk staff able to open the new branch
Members or payments copied into it

steps.action: Look at billing of the new branch
user_sees: Its trial ends on the same day as the first branch's
must_not: A new free trial starting today for the branch
